sentence: This project compares molecular profiles across geographic areas to find the possible biological cause of why penile cancer is more common in some places.
This project builds a platform based on a large language model to study drug safety and effectiveness.
This project builds deep learning methods that use mobile single-lead electrocardiograms to estimate a person's risk of atrial fibrillation.
This project explores immunotherapy with T cells aimed at gangliosides to treat Ewing sarcoma, a bone tumor in children.
This project builds machine learning models that find the genomic variants causing hypertension in each individual.
This project tries to find out how signals in airway cells lead to chronic lung rejection after lung transplantation.
This project tests a methadone-based pain management approach in children having major surgeries to lower opioid use.
This project uses mass spectrometry to study proteomes in neuron and organoid models of Rett syndrome and autism.
This project uses machine learning to find subtypes of cognitive control network changes in children with obsessive-compulsive disorder.
This project provides support for labs that use Neuropixels electrophysiology probes.
This project builds methods that use deep learning with transformers to compare molecular sequences and study molecular evolution.
This project works to better understand and treat cancer across many areas of cancer research.
This project builds antibody-like molecules from a triangular RNA scaffold to target, detect and treat prostate cancer.
This project builds a system using optical coherence tomography angiography to spot early signs of vision-threatening problems from diabetic retinopathy.
This project studies how lasting changes in astrocyte structure after cocaine use affect what astrocytes do and drug seeking behavior.
This project investigates how a protein activated by replication stress affects tumor growth and resistance to osimertinib in lung cancer models.
This project studies how neural stem cells behave in the embryonic mouse neocortex as brain tissue forms.
This project studies the long-term risk of going from antinuclear antibody positivity to autoimmune disease and uses AI to build models.
This project studies how genetics, age, lifestyle and environmental exposure interact to affect disease susceptibility.
This project offers microscopes, spectroscopy instruments and image-processing software for imaging in cancer research.
